plugins.Author: Knightmore
plugins.Name: Henchman
plugins.Description:
Your personal Henchman doing all the heavy lifting for you!

- A/B Rank Farmer
- Hunt Logs
- Hunt Bills
- Retainer Creation
- Character Creation
- Multi Account Trading
- Multicharacter Ocean Fishing Cycler
- Chocobokeeps
and more to come.
plugins.Changelog:
- **Bring Your A/B Game**
  - Increased the A-rank roaming radius from 10 to 50 yalms so searches can scan sooner around approximate spawn points.
  - Hunt roaming now skips to the next scan point when movement stalls.

- **Testy Trader**
  - Added an Add All button that adds every tradable item in the selected category to the active trade plan, including HQ variants.
  - Fixed a race that could start the return route before the boss’s world visit had finished.

- **General**
  - Added an Export Log button to every feature for easier troubleshooting.

plugins.Author: Knightmore
plugins.Name: Knightshopper
plugins.Punchline: Knightshopping made easy - ShopMore, click less.
plugins.Description:
Your personal shopper who will take care of all your currency spendings!

Knightshopper: because even knights deserve a squire for their shopping.
plugins.Changelog:
- **Shopping Lists**
  - Added Teamcraft list import from the clipboard on every currency tab. It automatically selects the currency and shows a preview before saving.

- **Support Logs**
  - Added an **Export support logs** button in Settings that bundles Knightshopper, MappingTheRealm, and vnavmesh logs into a ZIP.
  - Game error messages are now logged during active purchases and included in future exports.

plugins.Author: Knightmore
plugins.Name: MogVault
plugins.Punchline: Lost an item? Your moogle knows where, kupo!
plugins.Description:
Remembers what your characters, retainers and free companies hold, so you can look it up from any character.

- Item search across characters, retainers, FC chests, glamour dresser and armoire
- Storage info in the game's item tooltips (optional)
- Jobs, currencies, quests and collections of all characters
- Glamour dresser outfits and armoire per character
- Retainer gil, items and ventures
- FC chest, credits and submarine/airship voyages
- Houses, apartments and private chambers with last entry time
- Hide names for screenshots, daily backups
- IPC for other plugins
plugins.Changelog:
- **Free Companies**
  - New block icon ignores a free company and deletes its saved data
  - Ignored free companies can be allowed again in the settings

plugins.Author: Knightmore
plugins.Name: MappingTheRealm
plugins.Punchline: From here to there, by land, sea, sky, or aetheryte.
plugins.Description: Mapping The Realm plans routes across FFXIV zones, using vnavmesh to find paths within each zone and linking them by walking, flying, ferry, teleport and other movement options. Pick a destination and find the shortest route.
plugins.Changelog:
- Travel
  - The destination dropdown now shows areas with regular routes available to your character, including The Waking Sands. Areas without a named region appear under Other areas.
- Support Logs
  - Added interaction-range diagnostics that identify the exact live object and show why MappingTheRealm skipped movement, completed an approach, or failed to get into range.
